name: Router::rank_env_images

test_list.description: Exact repository plus full commit or exact lockfile hash returns trusted catalog entries without S1 calls.
A matching lockfile hash from a different repository goes through near-miss S1 ranking.
A repository-only or abbreviated commit match is a near miss and is considered only by bounded lexical filtering and S1.
Tied rankings are deterministic by image ID.
Duplicate catalog IDs fail before exact selection or S1 scoring.
Candidate count, query, IDs, commit and hash identity fields, and metadata obey hard ceilings before scoring.
An S1 error returns bounded lexical candidates with fallback reasons.
An S1 timeout returns bounded lexical candidates with fallback reasons.
Only candidates inside the configured shortlist are submitted to S1.

inputs.name: manifest
inputs.description: Trusted repository identity and bounded environment requirements.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Trusted catalog metadata joined to real listed image IDs.

output_description: Exact matches or bounded semantically ranked near misses whose IDs come only from the supplied catalog.
